subject.title: feat(nodes): improve computer-use screen capture and node routing

question: Should `scripts/package-mac-app.sh` support producing a helper-less macOS app through `SKIP_MLX_TTS=1`, and if so, is that strictly a documented local-developer workflow rather than a release-capable package path?
rationale: The new environment switch changes what the packaging entry point may ship, while the PR supplies neither an upgrade/release contract nor real runtime proof for an app without the helper.

options.title: Keep MLX TTS mandatory
options.body: Remove the new environment switch and solve local toolchain constraints without allowing the packaging path to omit a bundled runtime helper.

options.title: Allow developer-only skip
options.body: Keep the switch only with explicit developer-only documentation, a guard against release packaging, and proof that helper-dependent features fail clearly when absent.

recommendation.title: Keep MLX TTS mandatory
recommendation.body: Remove the new environment switch and solve local toolchain constraints without allowing the packaging path to omit a bundled runtime helper.
